• HTTPS only (Let's Encrypt on the host proxy); secure cookies in production
• Google-only sign-in with an e-mail allow-list; no passwords stored
• Docs are never public files: Django checks access → X-Accel-Redirect → internal nginx location
• CSRF on every POST · require_safe / require_POST · JSON APIs answer 401, not redirects
• nginx POST rate limit 5 r/s per real client IP (proxy IPs trusted only from private ranges)
• Blog HTML sanitised with nh3; quiz Markdown renders with raw HTML disabled
• Cache-Control: no-store on personal data · CSV formula-injection guard
• Secrets only in .env · the vault repo is public, so private notes stay out of it
• Push to main → GitHub Actions (tests, docs build) → SSH as 'deploy' → forced command deploy/ci.sh → deploy.sh
• The deploy key can only run: deploy · build-docs · load-practice · sync-blog · backup · status
(Actions → Server tasks for manual runs); the blog key can only run sync-blog
• nginx re-resolves web through Docker DNS → no lasting 502 after the web container restarts
• cron: blog sync every 6 h (fallback) · backup_db.sh 02:30 (14 days) · clearsessions 03:00 ·
• DB rows (courses, enrolments, scores) are not in git: copy backups/ off the VPS too
• Restore: gunzip -c backups/portal-DATE.sql.gz | docker compose exec -T db psql -U portal portal
